# The Metropolitan Museum of Art
> The Met presents over 5,000 years of art from around the world through collections, exhibitions, scholarship, and visitor experiences.

The Metropolitan Museum of Art is one of the world’s largest art museums, with locations at The Met Fifth Avenue and The Met Cloisters. Its website provides access to collection records, exhibition information, art-historical essays, publications, research resources, educational materials, and practical visitor planning tools.

## Museum Overview
- [Home](https://www.metmuseum.org/): Main entry point to The Met’s collections, exhibitions, stories, and visitor information.
- [About The Met](https://www.metmuseum.org/about-the-met): Museum history, mission, leadership, and institutional overview.
- [The Met Fifth Avenue](https://www.metmuseum.org/locations/the-met-fifth-avenue): Information about the main museum building, galleries, and visitor access.
- [The Met Cloisters](https://www.metmuseum.org/locations/the-met-cloisters): Information about the museum and gardens devoted to medieval art and architecture.
- [Departments and Centers](https://www.metmuseum.org/about-the-met/curatorial-departments): Overview of curatorial departments and specialized museum centers.
- [Press](https://www.metmuseum.org/press): Official museum press releases, announcements, and media resources.

## Visit
- [Plan Your Visit](https://www.metmuseum.org/plan-your-visit): Hours, locations, admissions, accessibility, and essential visitor guidance.
- [Hours and Admission](https://www.metmuseum.org/plan-your-visit/hours-and-admission): Current opening hours, ticketing details, and admission policies.
- [Directions](https://www.metmuseum.org/plan-your-visit/directions): Transportation and route information for visiting museum locations.
- [Accessibility](https://www.metmuseum.org/plan-your-visit/accessibility): Accessibility services, accommodations, and visitor support resources.
- [Group Visits](https://www.metmuseum.org/plan-your-visit/group-visits): Planning information for school, tour, and other organized groups.
- [Dining](https://www.metmuseum.org/plan-your-visit/dining): On-site dining options and restaurant information for visitors.

## Collection and Artworks
- [The Met Collection](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection): Search and browse artworks from across The Met’s collection online.
- [Collection Highlights](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search#!?showOnly=highlights%7CwithImage): Explore notable works with images from the museum’s holdings.
- [Departments](https://www.metmuseum.org/about-the-met/curatorial-departments): Browse collection areas by curatorial department and specialty.
- [Open Access at The Met](https://www.metmuseum.org/about-the-met/policies-and-documents/open-access): Reuse policy and access information for public-domain collection images.
- [Collection API](https://metmuseum.github.io/): Public API documentation for accessing collection object data programmatically.
- [Search the Collection](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search): Direct search interface for object records, artists, and departments.

## Exhibitions and Events
- [Exhibitions](https://www.metmuseum.org/exhibitions): Current, upcoming, and past exhibitions across museum locations.
- [Now On View](https://www.metmuseum.org/exhibitions/now-at-the-met): Current exhibitions and installations open to visitors now.
- [Exhibitions at The Met Fifth Avenue](https://www.metmuseum.org/exhibitions/listings/met-fifth-avenue): Exhibition listings for the main museum building.
- [Exhibitions at The Met Cloisters](https://www.metmuseum.org/exhibitions/listings/met-cloisters): Exhibition listings for The Met Cloisters.
- [Events](https://www.metmuseum.org/events): Talks, performances, tours, family programs, and special events.
- [Exhibition Catalogs](https://www.metmuseum.org/met-publications): Museum publications including many exhibition catalogs and scholarly titles.

## Research and Scholarship
- [Heilbrunn Timeline of Art History](https://www.metmuseum.org/toah/): Scholarly essays, chronologies, and thematic resources on global art history.
- [MetPublications](https://www.metmuseum.org/met-publications): Free and print publications including catalogs, journals, and collection studies.
- [Libraries and Research Centers](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/libraries-and-research-centers): Research libraries, archives, and study resources for scholars.
- [Thomas J. Watson Library](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/libraries-and-research-centers/watson-library): Main research library with art-history collections and services.
- [The Met Bulletin](https://www.metmuseum.org/met-publications/the-met-bulletin): Museum journal featuring collection-based scholarship and essays.
- [Research Out Loud](https://www.metmuseum.org/perspectives/research-out-loud): Articles highlighting new scholarship, discoveries, and museum research.

## Learning and Educational Resources
- [Learn with Us](https://www.metmuseum.org/learn): Educational programs, resources, and opportunities for learners of all ages.
- [Teens](https://www.metmuseum.org/learn/teens): Teen programs, internships, and creative learning opportunities.
- [Families](https://www.metmuseum.org/events/families): Family-friendly events, activities, and museum programs.
- [Educators](https://www.metmuseum.org/learn/educators): Teaching resources, professional development, and classroom materials.
- [Kids and Families](https://www.metmuseum.org/learn/kids-and-families): Activities and resources designed for children and caregivers.
- [Audio Guide](https://www.metmuseum.org/visit/audio-guide): Information about museum audio tours and interpretive content.

## Digital Content and Stories
- [Perspectives](https://www.metmuseum.org/perspectives): Editorial stories, interviews, essays, and behind-the-scenes features.
- [Videos](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/online-features/met-360-project): Digital features and immersive online experiences from the museum.
- [The Met 360° Project](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/online-features/met-360-project): Panoramic video experiences exploring museum spaces and architecture.
- [Online Features](https://www.metmuseum.org/art/online-features): Curated digital projects, thematic explorations, and multimedia content.
- [Blog and Stories Search](https://www.metmuseum.org/perspectives/search-the-collection): Editorial and interpretive content connected to artworks and themes.

## Support and Membership
- [Support The Met](https://www.metmuseum.org/support): Ways to donate and support the museum’s mission and programs.
- [Membership](https://engage.metmuseum.org/members/membership/?promocode=60317): Membership options, benefits, and joining information.
- [Donate](https://www.metmuseum.org/support/donate): Direct giving options for individual supporters.
- [Corporate Support](https://www.metmuseum.org/support/corporate-support): Sponsorship and partnership opportunities for organizations.
- [Planned Giving](https://www.metmuseum.org/support/planned-giving): Legacy giving and estate-planning support options.
- [Volunteer](https://www.metmuseum.org/support/volunteer): Volunteer opportunities and participation information.

## Careers and Opportunities
- [Careers](https://www.metmuseum.org/about-the-met/careers): Job openings and employment information at the museum.
- [Internships](https://www.metmuseum.org/about-the-met/internships): Internship programs for students and emerging professionals.
- [Fellowships](https://www.metmuseum.org/about-the-met/fellowships): Fellowship opportunities supporting advanced research and training.
- [Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion](https://www.metmuseum.org/about-the-met/diversity-equity-and-inclusion): Institutional commitments, initiatives, and related information.
- [Contact Information](https://www.metmuseum.org/about-the-met/contact-information): Museum contact details for departments, services, and inquiries.
